It says screening can find abnormal cells early and help prevent or treat cervical cancer, but test results can also be wrong.","key_points":["Cervical cancer starts in the cervix, and precancer cells can turn into cancer if not removed.","Screening looks for abnormal cells before symptoms and may find cancer early when it is easier to treat.","Common screening tests are the Pap test, the HPV test, and the HPV/Pap cotest.","Screening timing depends on age and health history, and some people need more or less screening."]}

{"main_idea":"Prediabetes is a condition where blood sugar is higher than normal but not yet diabetes. It raises the risk of type 2 diabetes and other health problems, but lifestyle changes may delay or prevent it.","key_points":["Prediabetes usually happens because of insulin resistance or not making enough insulin.","Being overweight and not being physically active are major factors in prediabetes.","Most people have no symptoms, but some may have dark skin or small skin growths on the neck or armpits.","It is diagnosed with blood tests like fasting plasma glucose and A1C, and healthy lifestyle changes may help prevent or delay diabetes."]}

{"main_idea":"Bird flu, also called avian influenza, is a virus that mainly infects birds but can sometimes spread to people. The main point is that human infection is rare, but it can be serious, so people should know the risks, symptoms, treatment, and prevention steps.","key_points":["The virus usually infects birds, but some types have caused infections in people in many regions, including rare cases in the United States.","People can get bird flu from infected birds, contaminated surfaces, breathing virus droplets or dust, and very rarely from other animals, other people, or unsafe food and raw milk.","People at higher risk include poultry workers, animal handlers, wildlife biologists, disease control workers, lab workers, veterinarians, and travelers to places where bird flu is present.","Bird flu may cause no symptoms or flu-like illness, is diagnosed with lab testing, is treated with antivirals, and can be reduced by protective gear, handwashing, and safe food handling."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains what carbohydrates are and why they matter in the diet. It says carbs give the body energy, but people should choose healthier types and watch added sugar.","key_points":["Carbohydrates are one of the three main nutrients, and the body turns them into glucose for energy.","The three main types are sugars, starches, and fiber.","Carbs are found in grains, fruits, dairy, legumes, sweets, drinks with sugar, and starchy vegetables.","People should choose whole grains and fiber-rich foods, limit added sugar, and ask a provider before starting a low-carb diet."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains hypothyroidism and gives basic facts about it. It says the condition can often be controlled with medicine, but untreated cases can cause serious problems.","key_points":["Hypothyroidism is an underactive thyroid that does not make enough hormones for the body.","Common causes include Hashimoto's disease, thyroiditis, surgery, radiation, medicines, and rare pituitary or iodine problems.","People at higher risk include women, older adults, pregnant or recently pregnant people, and those with certain diseases or a family history.","Symptoms are often slow to appear and may include fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, dry skin, depression, and goiter."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains hemophilia, a rare bleeding disorder, and how it affects clotting and bleeding. It also says hemophilia can be inherited or acquired, and that treatment usually replaces the missing clotting factor.","key_points":["Hemophilia can cause too much bleeding after injury or surgery and bleeding inside the body.","The main types are Hemophilia A from low factor VIII and Hemophilia B from low factor IX.","Most hemophilia is inherited on the X chromosome, but rare acquired hemophilia can happen from autoantibodies.","Diagnosis uses medical history, family history, physical exam, and blood or genetic tests, and treatment often uses replacement clotting factor."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains fibromyalgia, a long-lasting condition that causes body pain and fatigue. It says the cause is unknown and treatment focuses on easing symptoms, not curing it.","key_points":["Fibromyalgia causes chronic pain, tiredness, and trouble sleeping, along with other body and thinking symptoms.","The exact cause is unknown, but pain processing, genetics, and other diseases may play a role.","It is more common in women, middle-aged people, people with certain diseases, and those with a family history.","Diagnosis can be hard because there is no specific test, and treatment usually combines medicines, lifestyle changes, talk therapy, and some complementary therapies."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains what saliva is and why it is important for a healthy mouth. It also explains dry mouth, its causes, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.","key_points":["Saliva helps moisten food, protect teeth, and fight mouth and throat infections.","Dry mouth means there is not enough saliva, and it can make eating, talking, and swallowing hard.","Many things can cause dry mouth, including medicines, diseases, radiation, chemotherapy, nerve damage, mouth breathing, and alcohol or tobacco use.","Treatment depends on the cause, but people may need medicine changes, artificial saliva, and home care to reduce symptoms and protect teeth."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains what a conspiracy theory is and how the term is used. It says such beliefs often lack strong evidence and can cause serious harm.","key_points":["A conspiracy theory blames hidden powerful groups for events when other explanations are more likely.","The term usually has a negative meaning and is different from a real conspiracy.","Such beliefs can resist falsification and are often tied to distrust, bias, and some psychological traits.","They have been linked to prejudice, violence, public health harms, and broader social damage."]}

{"main_idea":"Workplace bullying is repeated mistreatment at work that harms people. It can come from bosses, peers, or subordinates, and it can hurt both workers and the whole organization.","key_points":["It may include verbal, nonverbal, psychological, or physical abuse, and humiliation.","It is often hard to notice because bullies may act within workplace rules and policies.","The behavior can be covert or overt and may lower morale and change organizational culture.","Researchers define it as repeated, harmful mistreatment over time that targets people who have trouble defending themselves."]}

{"main_idea":"This text describes Maryland Route 537 and its old road sections in Chesapeake City, Maryland. It explains that MD 537 is made of former parts of US 213 and gives its history and route changes.","key_points":["MD 537 is a group of unsigned state highway segments in Cecil County, Maryland.","The routes are former pieces of the old US 213 alignment in Chesapeake City.","Some sections came from early state road work, and others came from bridge approach roads.","After the new Chesapeake City Bridge opened in 1949, the bypassed roads became MD 537 and most later changed to county or municipal maintenance."]}

{"main_idea":"The text explains the Australian Capital Territory and its role as Australia's federal capital area. It says Canberra is there, and the territory hosts major government, legal, and national institutions.","key_points":["The ACT was created as the seat of government after Australian federation and Canberra was founded and named in 1913.","It is an enclave within New South Wales and includes Canberra, some small towns, and Namadgi National Park.","The territory contains key national institutions, embassies, museums, and several university campuses.","A local assembly governs the ACT, but the Commonwealth can override laws and still controls the Parliamentary Triangle."]}

{"main_idea":"Cohoes Falls is a waterfall on the Mohawk River in New York. The text explains its Mohawk name, cultural meaning, and later use for industry and canal routes.","key_points":["The Mohawk name means a boat is submerged in the water.","Haudenosaunee tradition links the falls to The Great Peacemaker and the Confederacy.","The falls were admired by travelers and poets, including Thomas Moore.","A dam and water rights later supported textile mills and power companies, and the Erie Canal route changed over time."]}

{"main_idea":"This text explains bongkrek acid and the poisoning it causes in contaminated fermented foods. It says the toxin is very dangerous, and it has caused many deaths and a food ban in Indonesia.","key_points":["Bongkrek acid is a heat-stable respiratory toxin made by Burkholderia gladioli pathovar cocovenenans in contaminated coconut or corn foods.","It blocks the mitochondrial ADP/ATP carrier and stops ATP from leaving the mitochondria.","Poisoning can damage the liver, brain, and kidneys and can cause vomiting, diarrhea, urinary retention, abdominal pain, and sweating.","A major history of outbreaks began with tempe Bongkrek in Java, and Indonesia banned its production in 1988 after many cases and high mortality."]}

{"main_idea":"This text gives a profile of Yilo Krobo Municipal District in Eastern Region, Ghana. It describes its location, geography, climate, vegetation, population, and settlement pattern, and says it became a municipal district in 2012.","key_points":["Yilo Krobo Municipal District is one of the districts in Eastern Region, Ghana, with Somanya as its capital.","It was created in 1988 as Yilo Krobo District and was elevated to municipal district status on 6 February 2012.","The municipality has a mountainous landscape, a dry equatorial climate, and semi-deciduous forest and savannah vegetation.","Its population was 87,847 in 2010 and most people live in rural areas, with farming as the main occupation."]}

{"main_idea":"A binary search tree is a rooted binary tree used for fast search, insert, and delete. Its performance depends on tree height and can become slow if the tree is not balanced.","key_points":["Each node has larger keys on the right and smaller keys on the left.","BSTs support fast lookup, addition, removal, traversal, and sorting uses.","Arbitrary insertions can make a BST degenerate into a linked list.","Self-balancing trees like AVL trees were created to limit worst-case height."]}

{"main_idea":"The Act of Tilsit was a 1918 declaration by Lithuanian leaders in Prussian Lithuania. It called for joining Lithuania Minor with Lithuania Proper and helped later Lithuanian claims to Klaipėda.","key_points":["It was signed in Tilsit on November 30, 1918 by 24 members of the National Council of Lithuania Minor.","The signatories wanted a single Lithuanian state and detachment of northern East Prussia from Germany.","The act was not signed by some main pro-Lithuanian leaders, and some evidence suggests it was mainly a show document.","It later became an important propaganda tool in the Klaipėda Revolt, and some signatories were later persecuted by the Nazis."]}

{"main_idea":"The text is a biography of Mykolas Burokevičius and his role in Lithuanian communist politics. It also describes his later trial and prison sentence for actions linked to the January 1991 events.","key_points":["He was born in 1927, studied in Vilnius, and worked in communist party institutions in Lithuania.","In 1990 he led a pro-CPSU Communist Party of Lithuania that wanted Lithuania to stay in the USSR.","His party opposed Lithuanian independence and helped create bodies meant to support Soviet rule.","He was tried and sentenced in 1999 for organizing violence and anti-state groups, then later brought a case to the European Court of Human Rights."]}

{"main_idea":"This text tells about Gagik II, the last king of the Bagratuni dynasty in Armenia. It also describes the wars around his rule and how Armenia resisted Byzantium and the Seljuq Turks.","key_points":["Gagik II ruled Ani from 1042 to 1045 before Bagratid rule collapsed in Armenia.","Byzantine emperors tried to annex Armenia after the deaths of Hovhannes-Smbat and Ashot IV.","Armenian leaders defeated a Byzantine army near Ani and crowned Gagik II king.","Gagik II and Vahram Pahlavuni then fought the Seljuq Turks and won a major victory near Lake Sevan."]}

{"main_idea":"Cibao International Airport is a major airport in Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic. It is the country's third-busiest airport and serves many travelers to and from the region.","key_points":["The airport is also called Santiago Airport and is located southeast of Santiago city center.","It mainly serves Dominicans, Haitians in the Cibao Region, and more tourists and missionary workers now use it.","JetBlue is the main international airline, with many daily flights to New York, Newark, and Boston.","The airport has grown through several expansions, and its owners plan more runway and taxiway work."]}

{"main_idea":"Świętokrzyski National Park is a protected area in central Poland. It protects the Holy Cross Mountains, important forests, wildlife, and historic sites.","key_points":["The park is in Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship and covers the highest ridge of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains.","Its protection began before World War I, and the national park was created in 1950.","The park is known for rich forests, rare trees, and many protected animal species.","It also contains important religious, historic, and cultural monuments near Łysa Góra and Bodzentyn."]}
